description: This file defines an abstract class Supervisor within the PhpSpreadsheet library, responsible for managing style supervision in spreadsheets. It provides methods for binding a parent, retrieving active sheet and cell information, cloning, and exporting style data.

classes.name: Supervisor
classes.description: An abstract class that provides a framework for style supervision in PhpSpreadsheet. It manages parent relationships, clone behavior, and exporting style arrays, serving as a base for specific style components.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the supervisor object, setting whether it is a supervisor or not.

methods.name: bindParent
methods.description: Associates this supervisor with a parent object, such as a Spreadsheet or another Supervisor, and optionally sets the parent property name.

methods.name: getIsSupervisor
methods.description: Returns whether this object is a supervisor.

methods.name: getActiveSheet
methods.description: Retrieves the currently active worksheet from the parent.

methods.name: getSelectedCells
methods.description: Returns the selected cell range in the active sheet.

methods.name: getActiveCell
methods.description: Returns the active cell in the active sheet.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Creates a deep clone of the object, cloning internal objects except for the parent.

methods.name: exportArray
methods.description: Final method that calls the abstract exportArray1 method to export style as an array.

methods.name: exportArray1
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses for exporting style data as an array.

methods.name: exportArray2
methods.description: Helper method to populate an export array with style properties, handling recursive export of Style objects.

methods.name: getSharedComponent
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the shared style component.

methods.name: getStyleArray
methods.description: Abstract method to build a style array from subcomponents.
